status: Retired mixed-severity exploratory reused-TEST study; not the new clean/moderate training or primary evaluation cohort
target_definition: useful = human DIRECT_VISIBLE AND ORIGINAL raw native 2D error<=8px; EXTERNAL/SELF and inaccurate DIRECT are negatives; unknown semantic states excluded
coordinate_error_source: corrected_measurements only; never projected/completed hidden coordinates
initialization_limit: Alternate WD initializer may use all independently predicted points, including fixed-H points, for seed only; fixed-H points are excluded from final/staged refinement fits
interpretation: Usability selection is not a standalone external occlusion classifier
Original self-H stays fixed; human SELF points outside that mask can remain eligible
Reference XY/pose are existing annotation/reconstruction, not independently measured physical ground truth
Selected-head confidence and corrected-coordinate precision are different targets
No TEST results here may select or retune future models or policies

branch_counterfactual.interpretation: Single-family and WD arms share exactly the same P_usable and corrected observations; their pose difference isolates branch choice, not new coordinate measurements.
